claim_text: Implement Water Management Plans (WMPs) at all operational sites.
context_text: Water Implement Water Management Plans (WMPs) at all operational sites.；Implementation of WMPs has been deferred due to a refocus and pivot on developing a Water Strategy.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 目标陈述要求在所有运营点实施WMPs，但绩效栏明确写明该实施已被deferred，与该表述相悖。
notes: 目标/承诺型 claim，被同页绩效结果直接否定。
